description: This file contains SQL scripts for creating views, packages, procedures, triggers, synonyms, and grants related to database configuration and summary in an Oracle database environment.

methods.name: getDatabaseSummary
methods.description: Retrieves a database summary as an XMLType, including service name, host, character set, and version info.

methods.name: folderDatabaseSummary
methods.description: Creates or updates an XML resource with the database summary and sets access control.

methods.name: setXDBport
methods.description: Updates the XDB configuration XML with a new port number for HTTP or FTP.

methods.name: setHTTPport
methods.description: Sets the HTTP port in the XDB configuration.

methods.name: setFTPport
methods.description: Sets the FTP port in the XDB configuration.
